sources.entry: StickyNotes - A Windows 10-esque Sticky Notes app implemented in AppKit.

summary.one_liner: A macOS sticky notes app built with AppKit, modeled on the Windows 10 Sticky Notes app.
summary.what_it_does: The README is very short and only states that StickyNotes is a Windows 10-like Sticky Notes app implemented in AppKit. It gives no details on features, screenshots, or usage. The listing in the awesome-list context places it under Productivity as a macOS app. Beyond that, the README does not describe what the app can do.
use_cases: keep quick desktop notes on mac
replace windows sticky notes on macos
jot down reminders on the desktop
stack: Swift or Objective-C (not stated in README)
notable: Mimics the look and behavior of Windows 10 Sticky Notes
Native macOS app built on AppKit
caveats: README is minimal; no setup, feature list, or build instructions are given
Platform is macOS only, as implied by AppKit
